note: Factory only. A vault cannot be created on this chain: the build path needs a PancakeSwap V3 pool holding WBNB to flash from, and BSC testnet has none. See AUDIT.md.
beaconOwnerIs: Flap Guardian (BNB testnet). Same bytecode as chain 56 resolves a different Guardian by chain id, which is what this deployment demonstrates.

supersedes.reason: Second Flap interaction risk report (2026-09-03). Findings 1-3 of that report were already fixed and deployed before it was written. This deployment carries the three new ones: the build swap now has a slippage floor of its own (MAX_BUILD_SLIP_BPS = 25) because the exit path's 300 bps floor lands below the flash repayment bound and would constrain nothing; and the on-chain schema strings no longer promise a five-minute cadence when idle (it is hourly) nor a flat 70% to holders on a manual harvest (the 0.5% bounty comes out first).

retiredNote: Every address this project has ever deployed and replaced. Registering any of them with Flap would bind a token to superseded code. tools/check-docs.py reads this list, so a redeploy updates one file rather than a constant in the checker.

upgradeAuthority.LeverBeacon: owns the vault implementation; Flap Guardian
upgradeAuthority.LeverFactoryBeacon: owns the factory implementation; Flap Guardian
upgradeAuthority.note: Both beacons transfer ownership to the Guardian inside their own constructors, so the deployer never holds upgrade authority for a single block. Nothing else in this project has an owner, admin, or role of any kind.
